taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS MeF schema for Schedule 1.

ssn.rationale: The filer's SSN is a header field on the form not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule 1 MeF schema.

taxable_refunds_credits_offsets.rationale: StateLocalIncomeTaxRefundAmt corresponds to Line 1 — taxable refunds, credits, or offsets of state and local income taxes.

alimony_received.rationale: AlimonyReceivedAmt under AlimonyReceivedGrp corresponds to Line 2a — alimony received.

alimony_received_date.rationale: DivorceOrSeparationAgreementDt under AlimonyReceivedGrp corresponds to Line 2b — date of divorce/separation agreement for alimony received.

business_income_loss.rationale: BusinessIncomeLossAmt corresponds to Line 3 — business income or loss from Schedule C.

other_gains_losses.rationale: OtherGainLossAmt corresponds to Line 4 — other gains or losses from Form 4797.

rental_royalty_income_loss.rationale: RentalRealEstateIncomeLossAmt corresponds to Line 5 — rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, etc.

farm_income_loss.rationale: NetFarmProfitLossAmt corresponds to Line 6 — farm income or loss from Schedule F.

unemployment_compensation.rationale: UnemploymentCompAmt corresponds to Line 7 — total unemployment compensation received.

net_operating_loss.rationale: NetOperatingLossDeductionAmt corresponds to Line 8a — net operating loss deduction.

gambling_winnings.rationale: GamblingReportableWinningAmt corresponds to Line 8b — gambling winnings.

cancellation_of_debt.rationale: DebtCancellationAmt corresponds to Line 8c — cancellation of debt income.

foreign_income_exclusion.rationale: TotalIncomeExclusionAmt is the closest candidate for foreign income exclusion (Line 8d from Form 2555), though the name is somewhat generic.

income_from_form_8853.rationale: TotArcherMSAMedcrLTCAmt corresponds to Line 8e — income from Form 8853 (Archer MSAs and Long-Term Care Insurance Contracts).

income_from_form_8889.rationale: TotHSADistriHDHPAmt corresponds to Line 8f — income from Form 8889 (Health Savings Accounts).

alaska_permanent_fund_dividends.rationale: AlaskaPermanentFundDivAmt corresponds to Line 8g — Alaska Permanent Fund dividends.

wages_from_form_8919.rationale: CertainPenalInstnWagesAmt corresponds to Line 8h — wages from Form 8919.

nonqualified_deferred_comp.rationale: NonqlfyDeferredCompensationAmt corresponds to Line 8i — taxable income from nonqualified deferred compensation plans.

prizes_awards.rationale: PrizesAwardsAmt corresponds to Line 8j — prizes and awards.

taxable_medicaid_waiver.rationale: NontxMedicaidWaiverPymtAmt (idx 38) refers to nontaxable Medicaid waiver payments; no candidate clearly represents the taxable Medicaid waiver amount for Line 8k.

olympic_paralympic_medals.rationale: OlympicParalympicMedalUSOCAmt corresponds to Line 8l — Olympic and Paralympic medals and USOC prize money.

section_951_inclusion.rationale: Section951aInclusionAmt (lowercase 'a') corresponds to Line 8m — Section 951(a) Subpart F inclusion.

section_951a_inclusion.rationale: Section951AaInclusionAmt (uppercase 'A') corresponds to Line 8n — Section 951A(a) GILTI inclusion.

section_461_loss_limitation.rationale: ExcessBusinessLossAmt corresponds to Line 8o — Section 461(l) excess business loss adjustment.

pension_annuity_form_8915.rationale: No candidate element in the closed list corresponds to Line 8p — pension/annuity income from Form 8915 series.

scholarship_fellowship_grants.rationale: GrantsOrScholarshipsAmt corresponds to Line 8q — taxable scholarship or fellowship grant income.

nontaxable_medicaid_waiver_as_earned_inc.rationale: NontxMedicaidWaiverPymtAmt corresponds to Line 8r — nontaxable Medicaid waiver payments elected as earned income.

other_income_8z_amount.rationale: ActivityNotForProfitIncmAmt is the closest available candidate for miscellaneous other income on line 8z, though the schema may bundle multiple other-income items here.

other_income_8z_description.rationale: No candidate element represents a free-text description for line 8z other income; descriptions are not captured as discrete elements in this schema.

total_other_income.rationale: TotalOtherIncomeAmt corresponds to Line 9 — total of all amounts from lines 8a through 8z.

total_additional_income.rationale: TotalAdditionalIncomeAmt corresponds to Line 10 — total additional income carried to Form 1040, line 8.

educator_expenses.rationale: EducatorExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 11 — educator expenses deduction.

certain_business_expenses.rationale: BusExpnsReservistsAndOthersAmt corresponds to Line 12 — certain business expenses of reservists, performing artists, and fee-basis government officials.

hsa_deduction.rationale: HealthSavingsAccountDedAmt corresponds to Line 13 — HSA deduction from Form 8889.

moving_expenses.rationale: MovingExpenseAmt corresponds to Line 14 — moving expenses for Armed Forces members.

deductible_self_employment_tax.rationale: DeductibleSelfEmploymentTaxAmt corresponds to Line 15 — deductible part of self-employment tax.

sep_simple_qualified_plans.rationale: SelfEmpldSepSimpleQlfyPlansAmt corresponds to Line 16 — self-employed SEP, SIMPLE, and qualified plan contributions.

self_employed_health_insurance.rationale: SelfEmpldHealthInsDedAmt corresponds to Line 17 — self-employed health insurance deduction.

penalty_early_withdrawal.rationale: PnltyOnErlyWthdrwOfSavingsAmt corresponds to Line 18 — penalty on early withdrawal of savings.

alimony_paid.rationale: AlimonyPaidAmt under AlimonyAmountGrp corresponds to Line 19a — alimony paid.

alimony_paid_recipient_ssn.rationale: RecipientSSN under AlimonyAmountGrp corresponds to Line 19b — SSN of the alimony recipient.

alimony_paid_date.rationale: DivorceOrSeparationAgreementDt under AlimonyAmountGrp corresponds to Line 19c — date of the divorce/separation agreement for alimony paid.

ira_deduction.rationale: IRADeductionAmt corresponds to Line 20 — IRA deduction.

student_loan_interest.rationale: StudentLoanInterestDedAmt corresponds to Line 21 — student loan interest deduction.

archer_msa_deduction.rationale: ArcherMSADeductionAmt corresponds to Line 23 — Archer MSA deduction from Form 8853.

other_adjustments_amount.rationale: OtherAdjustmentsTotalAmt corresponds to Line 24z — other adjustments to income.

other_adjustments_description.rationale: No candidate element represents a free-text description for line 24z other adjustments; such descriptions are not captured as discrete elements in this schema.

total_adjustments.rationale: TotalAdjustmentsAmt corresponds to Line 26 — total adjustments to income carried to Form 1040, line 10.
